Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review and our internal audits, we need to confirm that tenant key material is segregated and that escrowed keys are traceable back to their origination events. Specifically we need: 

- An escrow manifest showing per-tenant key identifiers (masked where necessary) and the escrow location (object id / date).
- The HSM attestation demonstrating module provenance and firmware/PSA date.
- A short MOP (method of procedure) describing your emergency/forced rotation workflow and expected RTO

- Rotation MOP assumes service-level cache flushing and short-lived KV caches; the runbook includes scripts to verify KV cache eviction using request traces.
